app_metadata.name: FireFighter Helper - Calculators
app_metadata.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for Android-first utility

hierarchy.label: text-sm font-medium tracking-[0.05em] uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-zinc-400

layout.alignment: left-align for labels and inputs, center-align for primary CTA

components.tabs: Extend existing Szybki Pomocnik tabs. Add 'Kalkulator' as a new tab trigger. Use standard active/inactive high-contrast states.
components.input: Full-width, h-12, rounded-md border px-4 text-base (minimum 16px to prevent iOS auto-zoom). Focus ring must be crisp: focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500.
components.button: Full-width, h-12, rounded-md font-medium text-base transition-colors flex items-center justify-center active:scale-[0.98]
components.result_card: Prominent, distinct card with slightly thicker border or distinct background tint. Very large typography for the calculated number (text-3xl font-bold) with a clear subtitle.

icons.usage: Functional only. Calculator icon for the tab. Info/HelpCircle icon for field descriptions. No decorative icons.

motion.interactions: Subtle press states on buttons (active:scale-95), smooth fade for result appearance.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT change the existing navigation structure. Simply add a new 'Kalkulator' tab next to 'tekst', 'zdjecie', and 'pdf' inside the Szybki Pomocnik category view.
Target .js files for implementation, not .tsx, as specified in the problem statement constraints.
Adhere to an Android-first Material-like utility layout: flat design, full-width inputs, clear borders, NO decorative gradients, NO heavy color blocks.
Support both Light and Dark mode using Tailwind's 'dark:' prefix, following the exact color mappings in this guideline.
Implement the dynamic field renderer based on the 'calculator_fields' schema, keeping state locally within the component.
Implement safe formula evaluation (e.g., using mathjs or a custom AST evaluator) to prevent security risks with standard JS eval().
Ensure all interactive elements and calculator inputs/outputs have descriptive 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='calc-input-volume', data-testid='calc-result').
